naming_note: CANONICAL feature stores (the ones used for every full-data number in the paper): DFN-CLIP -> canonical_clip_features_dfn.npz (full-data C=1 = 76.8%); LAION-2B -> laion_clip_features_clean.npz (== clip_features_laion_clean.npz, 76.1%). DO NOT use clip_features_clean.npz despite the 'clean' in its name: it is the pre-rebuild LEGACY/DRIFTED DFN store (full-data C=1 = 76.1%, 0.7pp off canonical). See Appendix A 'Feature-store unification'.
